description_en: Queries a list of gateways under the current account based on a conditional query
description_zh: 根据过滤条件查询当前用户账号名下的网关信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-gateways --online-state ONLINE --fuzzy-gw-eui 123456 --fuzzy-city CityName --fuzzy-name GatewayName --freq-band-plan-group-id 123 --is-enabled true --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field ONLINE_STATE_CHANGED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGateways

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by online/offline status.

If this parameter is not specified, gateways are not filtered by online status. Valid values: ONLINE, OFFLINE
parameters.help_zh:
网关在离线状态过滤。

如未传入此参数，则不限制在线状态。可取值为：ONLINE, OFFLINE
parameters.name: online_state

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy filter for city name
parameters.name: fuzzy_city

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy filter for gateway name
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: Filters gateways by frequency band plan group ID
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Filters gateways by enabled/disabled status.

If this parameter is not specified, gateways are not filtered by enabled/disabled status
parameters.help_zh:
网关启停用状态过滤。

如未传入此参数，则不限制启停状态
parameters.name: is_enabled

parameters.help_en: The offset of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of gateways to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的网关数量上限，大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid values: ONLINE_STATE_CHANGED_MILLIS
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为ONLINE_STATE_CHANGED_MILLIS
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort in ascending order. This parameter is used together with the SortingField parameter. Valid values:
true: ascending order.
false: descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_zh: 查询到的网关信息列表

Address.description_en: The detailed address of the gateway

AddressCode.description_en: The region ID of the gateway location, as defined by http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download

City.description_en: The city where the gateway is located

ClassBSupported.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports Class B mode
ClassBSupported.description_zh: 该网关是否支持 Class B 模式

ClassBWorking.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is currently working in Class B mode
ClassBWorking.description_zh: 该网关是否正工作在 Class B 模式下

CommunicationMode.description_en:
The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values:
FULL_DUPLEX: full-duplex.
HALF_DUPLEX: half-duplex
CommunicationMode.description_zh: 网关通信模式。可取值为FULL_DUPLEX(全双工）、HALF_DUPLEX(半双工)

Description.description_en: The custom description of the gateway

District.description_en: The district where the gateway is located

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is enabled
Enabled.description_zh: 该网关是否处于启用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band plan group ID of the gateway

GisCoordinateSystem.description_en: The coordinate system used for the gateway longitude and latitude. Valid values: WGS_84, GCJ_02
GisCoordinateSystem.description_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值为WGS_84，GCJ_02

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

Name.description_en: The custom name of the gateway

OnlineState.description_en: The online/offline status of the gateway. Valid values: ONLINE, OFFLINE
OnlineState.description_zh: 网关在离线状态，可取值为：ONLINE，OFFLINE

OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_en:
The time when the online/offline status last changed.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_zh:
最近一次在离线状态变更的时间。

格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

TimeCorrectable.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway can be used as a time correction gateway
TimeCorrectable.description_zh: 该网关是否可以作为时间校准网关

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of gateways that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的网关总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
